cards.title: Validation plus next step
cards.summary: Acknowledge the experience while moving toward a useful next action.
steps: Reflect the core experience without exaggerating.
Ask what kind of help is wanted: listening, skills, planning, information, or care navigation.

cards.title: Choice-based grounding
cards.summary: Use an external or cognitive anchor without assuming breath/body focus is comfortable.
cards.when_to_use: High arousal, dissociation, overwhelm, or racing thoughts.
steps: Offer options: name visible objects, describe a neutral object, count categories, listen for sounds, hold a familiar texture, or orient to date/place.
Reassess whether distress or safety changed.

cards.title: Basic-needs check
cards.summary: Identify unmet basic needs that can amplify distress.
cards.when_to_use: Overwhelm, irritability, fatigue, or cognitive fog.
steps: Check prescribed medication routine without changing it.
Check temperature, pain, sensory load, and safe positioning.
Check whether support from another person is needed.
